combo_label: At the Seaside × Photography × Norse Mythology

entries.clue: Rubber sandal held on by a toe post, slapping at every step
Hot fried potato pieces from the paper, best with a small wooden fork
Burst from the hot shoe that freezes a face and flattens it
Adjustable opening rated in f-stops: wide melts the background, narrow keeps all sharp
Eight-legged grey, best of all horses, foaled by a god in mare's shape
Wave-polished little find, pocketed on the walk home or skimmed if it is flat.
Shining god slain by a mistletoe dart guided by a trickster's hand
Mischief-maker bound in a cave beneath a serpent's venom until the last battle
Long heavy barrel that hauls a distant bird right into the frame
Giant wolf bound by a ribbon made of impossible things, waiting to swallow a god
